name: Do I need permits for my room remodeling project in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for my room remodeling project in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether permits are required for your room remodel in Daly City depends on the scope of the work. Minor cosmetic changes like painting or new flooring typically do not require permits. However, projects involving structural alterations, changes to the building's footprint, significant electrical or plumbing work, or additions will generally require permits from the City of Daly City. City Dweller, LLC can help you determine the specific permit requirements for your project and assist with the application process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually needed for structural, electrical, or plumbing changes, but not for minor cosmetic updates in Daly City. We can assist with permitting.
